fields.neuron: in_S=S.mid read of the input direction; in_R=R.mid read; out_R=R.out read of the write (L7: logit lens); out_S=S.out footprint of the write; out_logit=logit lens; out_R_neg=most suppressed; drivers=exact drivers; ctx=top firing [context, token] over 64 stories (21200..)
fields.head: ov_R/ov_S=diagonal-z copy reads (R.mid / S.mid); writes_R=R.mid read of the head's frequency-weighted mean write; qk_S=key tokens under the mean query; qk_self=tokens that seek themselves; attn_*=measured attention mass on previous/first/self token over 64 stories
